input.summary: During single-ball play, shoot the flashing right orbit to raise the regular Jackpot and the left gap to advance innings. Then play regular Multiball through Home Run, orbit, and a timed return to Home Run for Jackpot, Double Jackpot, and an innings-scaled Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Innings
quickInfo.summary: The left gap advances innings during normal play; each inning adds 100M to the eventual Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Regular Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Start from Players Choice at the right gap or from the bullpen route.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot cycle
quickInfo.summary: Home Run scores the jackpot, an orbit advances it, and a quick return to Home Run doubles the next award.

quickInfo.name: Seventh Inning
quickInfo.summary: Completing the sixth inning starts a four-ball mode whose left loop and right orbit build BIG HURT.

quickInfo.name: Grand Slam
quickInfo.summary: Completing G-R-A-N-D S-L-A-M starts a four-ball center-shot derby.

steps.text: During non-mode single-ball play, shoot the flashing right orbit to add 10M to the regular Jackpot.
Shoot the left gap during non-mode single-ball play to advance innings and raise the eventual Super Jackpot by 100M per completed inning.
Prepare regular multiball through Players Choice or the bullpen while keeping the Home Run feed under control.
Start multiball and shoot Home Run for the base jackpot.
Use the right orbit, or the left loop during multiball, to raise the jackpot before returning to Home Run.
Return to Home Run within the combo window for the doubled award, then repeat the orbit-to-Home-Run cycle.
After the required cycles, collect the Super Jackpot whose value reflects the innings built before the start.
If the sixth inning completes, switch to the Seventh Inning route and use the major loops to spell BIG HURT for doubled jackpots.

fallback.title: Players Choice multiball
fallback.when: Use this when inning advancement or the GRAND SLAM targets are feeding dangerously.

steps.text: Take the available Players Choice at the right gap.
Choose the regular multiball start.
Cash the first Home Run and orbit cycle without overbuilding the Super.

alternatives.title: Grand Slam Derby
alternatives.when: Use this when the GRAND SLAM letters are nearly complete and the center Home Run shot is reliable.

steps.text: Finish the remaining GRAND SLAM letters.
Enter the four-ball Derby.
Repeat controlled center Home Run shots during the protected window.

alternatives.title: Mode-before-multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when a valuable right-scoop mode is ready and its shots overlap the regular multiball route.

steps.text: Start the selected mode at the right scoop.
Begin the prepared regular multiball.
Use the extra balls to finish mode shots without abandoning Home Run cashouts.

buildsToward.title: World Series and the 900M Super ceiling

steps.text: Complete normal modes toward World Series.
Shoot the left gap during non-mode single-ball play to advance innings.
Enter multiball with a large innings multiplier.
Finish the jackpot cycle and collect the innings-scaled Super.

playfieldReferences.label: Inning advance
playfieldReferences.description: Left-side gap used to advance innings outside modes and multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Home Run shot
playfieldReferences.description: Central scoring shot used for jackpots and Derby awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Jackpot advance orbit
playfieldReferences.description: Orbit used to raise the next regular multiball jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiball advance loop
playfieldReferences.description: Loop that raises jackpot value during multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Players Choice
playfieldReferences.description: Right-side shot used to access Players Choice.

playfieldReferences.label: Mode start
playfieldReferences.description: Scoop used to start qualified normal modes.

techniques.name: Innings before multiball
techniques.instruction: Advance innings during single-ball play before committing to the jackpot cycle; the progress raises the final Super.

techniques.name: Orbit-to-Home-Run return
techniques.instruction: After raising the jackpot at an orbit, regain control quickly enough to return to Home Run inside the double window.

cautions.issue: The raised ramp and glove feeds can return the ball unpredictably.
cautions.response: Test their ejects before relying on a combo or mode start.

cautions.issue: Advancing innings delays the immediate Multiball start.
cautions.response: Take the ready start when match position values survival more than the larger Super ceiling.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Big Hurt and tournament treatment of Extra Ball and replay awards.
Test Home Run, orbit, glove, ramp, and eject returns.
input.simpleOverview: Frank Thomas' Big Hurt builds two values before regular Multiball: the flashing right orbit raises the Jackpot, and the left gap advances innings to raise the Super Jackpot. Build both during single-ball play, then shoot Home Run, an orbit, and Home Run again within five seconds for Jackpot and Double Jackpot before repeating the cycle for the Super.
